title: T1683.001 — Generate Content - Written Content
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Generate Content - Written Content with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated simulation of an attacker using an AI language model to write and deliver a spear phishing email, with defender evidence at each step

steps.title: Research the target
steps.caption: The attacker reads the employee's professional profile and the company's org chart. They learn names, projects, and the tone your executives use. oversharing feeds this step; trim public role details.
steps.defender: IdP and SaaS audit logs record token issuance, consent, sign-in location and API access.
